meta.name: onboarding
meta.description: Guides a first-time omo user through setup and the core workflow. Use when a new user asks to get started with omo.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 引导你完成 omo 的首次配置,并熟悉核心操作流程。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚接触 omo,想按引导一步步完成设置并学会基础用法。
copy.tagline_en: Set up omo and learn its core workflow step by step.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're new to omo and want guided setup and basics.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude会当向导，带新用户走完omo首次设置对谈：介绍功能、问是否迁入旧配置、经同意后翻看旧会话并估算节省、记下偏好、提议init-deep；全程说用户的语言，被拒的环节直接跳过。
howto.when: 当新用户要求开始使用omo，或omo首次启动时自动开始；之后可用 senpi --onboard 重新唤出。

say.note: 它会先给迁移方案，经你确认后才动手。

say.text: 请先别介绍，看看我以往的会话能省多少。
say.note: 需你授权读取历史会话，否则会当作拒绝跳过。

howto.what_en: When triggered, Claude walks a first-time omo user through setup conversationally: features, optional migration, past-session review, estimated savings, memory recording, and init-deep proposal. It speaks the user's language and skips declined lanes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a new user asks to get started with omo, or automatically on omo's first start; can be brought back later with `senpi --onboard`.

say_en.text: I want to get started with omo.
I'm coming from Claude Code and want to start with omo.
say_en.note: It will show a migration plan before applying anything.

say_en.text: Please skip the intro and look at my past sessions for savings.
say_en.note: This only proceeds if you allow reading that history.
